title: Premium Candle Product Shot
tests: Resolves a vague premium-style brief through reasonable visual choices without unnecessary clarification.

judge.summary: A polished, premium candle product shot with warm coordinated lighting, an amber glass vessel, and restrained scent-related styling, with no significant visible problems.

must_haves.item: A candle is clearly recognizable and is the dominant subject.
must_haves.why: The large, centrally placed amber jar candle and its lit wick clearly dominate the image.

must_haves.item: The candle and its container have clean, well-defined edges without obvious distortions.
must_haves.why: The glass rim, cylindrical vessel, label, and separate gold lid have coherent shapes and clean edges.

must_haves.item: The composition is uncluttered, with no distracting household objects.
must_haves.why: The few supporting props—wood, amber-colored resin, a stone platform, and the lid—are coordinated and leave the candle as the focal point.

must_haves.item: Controlled lighting and a coordinated background present the candle as a polished retail product.
must_haves.why: Warm directional lighting, deliberate shadows, and a neutral beige background create a cohesive luxury retail presentation.
